title: Swine - Warthog; Grunting and Squealing
author: TheKingOfGeeks360
changes: Common warthog (Phacochoerus africanus) grunting and squealing at a zoo. Trimmed to 0.05–2.97 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 1.7 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording.
